_note: Copy of /pricing (app/pricing/page.tsx, components/pricing/*). OFFER (USD, one-time; user 2026-10-07, replaced 'from $1,200'): $500 per connection; take 3 connections or more and one of them is free (3 for the price of 2); set up in 1 day. FREE TRIAL: 1 connection for 7 days, no card; keep it = a normal $500 connection that counts toward 3 for 2; stop = switched off, nothing to pay. PAYMENT: once, after it runs and before handover. Hosting and support after handover are not promised on this page (user 2026-10-07): keep the 'Where does it run?' answer as it is. The numbers live in lib/offer.ts (the quote, the plan cards and the counting example compute their prices from it); the sentences here spell them out, and lib/offer.test.mts checks that they agree. A plan's `count` is its number of connections (`plus`: that many or more); `badge` only when true. The real client stays anonymous and is told generically: no product-category words and no marketplace or warehouse brand names or logos on this page. Never name or compare with another vendor. The live demo and the case studies are never linked from this page (they are for email readers only).

items.a: One platform or account we connect: a marketplace account, a web store, your warehouse system. Each account counts once, so two accounts on the same marketplace are two connections.

items.q: How does 3 for the price of 2 work?
items.a: Take 3 connections or more and one of them is free. 2 connections are $1,000, 3 are $1,000, 4 are $1,500 and 5 are $2,000, one-time.

items.q: How does the free trial work?
items.a: We connect 1 platform or account and set it up in 1 day. It then runs for 7 days on your real data. No card and no commitment.
Keep it and it becomes a normal connection: $500 one-time, and it counts toward 3 for the price of 2. Or tell us to stop: we switch it off and you pay nothing.
Once, after it runs and before handover. The price is agreed in writing on the call, before we start.
1 day, once we have access to your platforms and accounts. We connect them, set the automations to your rules and hand it over.
Yes. You get the full codebase with the build. It is yours to keep, run and change, with no licence to renew.

items.q: Are there limits on orders or products?
items.a: No. There is no fee per order or per product. The price is set by the connections, not by how much you sell or how big your catalogue is.

items.q: Can we add a connection later?
items.a: Yes. Each extra connection is $500, one-time, agreed before we start.
You can run it on your own server. We can also set it up for you.
